response.sql: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, SUM(t.amount) as total_amount, COUNT(t.trans_id) as transaction_count, SUM(t.amount) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM trans) as fraction FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
